description: An injective language map preserves and reflects syntactic consistency of a theory in the shared natural-deduction calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.consistent_inclusion_iff.{u, v, u', v'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {K : FirstOrder.Language} (j : L →ᴸ K) (hj : j.Injective) (T : L.Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent (j.onTheory T) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T
